assets.name: reclaimer
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character cutout with actual transparent alpha background, one full-body character. A resourceful masked ammunition scavenger in an industrial vertical city, facing RIGHT in side three-quarter view, both boots and entire silhouette visible. Wearing a dark ink navy long utility coat with large flat folded panels, a worn ivory short shoulder cape, practical brass ammunition cylinder at belt, leather gloves, compact angular respirator and small amber visor, carrying a compact mechanical carbine pointing right at waist height. Modest original design, no existing character. Confident artisan fighter, independent graphic novel game art, clean cut-paper shapes, controlled hand painted edge texture, rich elegant shadow planes, oxidized brass accents, ivory highlights. A strong beautiful readable silhouette, restrained detail, readable down to 90 pixels tall, no photorealism, no anime style, no pixel art. Centered character fills 85 percent height, tall portrait approximately 1024x1536. Genuine transparent background, not a checkerboard drawing. No backdrop, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no numbers, no border, no UI, no watermark.

assets.name: workshop
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production environment illustration for a premium 2D ammunition-combo roguelike. Very wide 3:1 panoramic artwork. Scene: a scavenger's ammunition workshop inside an enormous mechanical transit station; a hand operated brass cartridge press and neatly arranged equipment tools on a large bench at the RIGHT third, a small glowing copper furnace, hanging mechanical parts, beautiful simple industrial shapes. LEFT two thirds a quiet dark ink navy wall and shadowed shelf with minimal detail, so live UI can be overlaid legibly. Large silhouettes, three restrained value planes, flat cut-paper graphic novel painting, subtle worn print grain, warm brass amber small lights and ivory edges, refined original independent game look. A sense of physical place and inviting craft, not a website background. Do not draw interface, text, letters, labels, currency, cards, inventory grids, humans, logos, watermark. No cyberpunk neon, no photorealism, no pixel art, no dense noise. Wide 1536x512 or closest supported 3:1.
